author: Times Radio
description:
“We can’t really let cyberspace be American territory.”

President Trump has said that any attempt to regulate Big Tech is “censorship”, and the way to “make social media safe” for children is to “take on The White House”, says political editor of The New World James Ball. 

James Ball was speaking to Ryan Tubridy on Times Radio.  Listen live every Sunday from 1-4pm.

description:
“You take guidance from them as to what’s needed, and you help them change their destiny.”

Author and Sunday Times contributor Stephen Armstrong explored the decline of Middlesbrough through the story of former Pallister Park estate resident Mick Wood, who emphasised the importance of working with residents to find a solution to problems facing local communities.

Stephen Armstrong was speaking to Rosie Wright and Guto Harri on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every weekend, 6-10am.

description:
“We are absolutely appalled by what happens, and we are fighting as much as we can within the framework of democracy against it.”

Measures taken by Andy Burnham and Ed Miliband against Israel must be directed “individually against the leaders” of the government, and should not be seen as an action against the state of Israel or the people of Israel, says former Israeli PM Ehud Olmert.

Ehud Olmert was speaking to Adam Boulton on Times Radio. Listen live every Sunday from 10am-1pm.

Dr Ben Kasstan-Dabush was speaking to Rosie Wright and Guto Harri on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every weekend, 6-10am.
